parkersburg-01.summary: A welcoming furnished one-bedroom cottage on Broad Street with a distinctive, comfortable interior, about seven minutes from downtown Parkersburg.
parkersburg-01.description: Broad Cottage is a one-bedroom furnished home in North Parkersburg with a warm and distinctive character. The living room features comfortable seating, a large TV, and natural light from a large window — a cozy spot to unwind after work or travel. The interior has a cohesive, lived-in feel with wood paneling and comfortable furnishings throughout. WVU Medicine Camden Clark and downtown Parkersburg are each about 7 minutes by car.
